context: Reach <5% false positive and <50% false negative on contact detection with a frozen V-JEPA 2.1 encoder plus a small trained head, on a high-quality mixed synthetic+real dataset.
prompt:
You are auditing one dataset label visually, blind to any model score. The attached image is a contact sheet of 16 frames sampled evenly across a single Tesla Sentry Mode clip, ordered left-to-right then top-to-bottom (chronological). Decide whether anything physically touches the car anywhere in the clip. Reply with exactly these lines:
VERDICT: contact | no_contact | indeterminate
ACTOR: who or what is involved (person, cart, animal, branch, camera shake, or none)
TIME: approximate second or moment of any contact, else none
VISIBILITY: anything occluded, off-camera, or too brief to judge
CONFIDENCE: low | medium | high
EVIDENCE: one or two sentences naming what is visible
response:
VERDICT: indeterminate
ACTOR: adjacent car’s opening door
TIME: frames 10–16, in the latter half of the clip
VISIBILITY: the door’s closest approach to the recording Tesla is off-camera; contact between sampled frames cannot be ruled out
CONFIDENCE: medium
EVIDENCE: A person stands beside the neighboring white car as its front door swings toward the recording Tesla. The door fills much of the foreground, but no visible impact or clear physical contact establishes that it touches the Tesla.
